summary: Grandson of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux, remembered in his grandfather's will as "a cripple child"; John's 1st cousin 6x removed.
bio: Jewel Lamoreaux was a son of James Lamoreaux, the eldest child of Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux, who was born on 3 January 1774, married Sarah Hunter and had ten children, among them Nathan and Jewel. Sarah Hunter was therefore probably Jewel's mother and Nathan his brother, though the family history itself puts a question mark after Jewel's name. His grandfather's will describes him as "Jewel Lamoreaux a cripple child" and gives him a share equal with his aunts. He was John's 1st cousin 6x removed.

openQuestions: Mother probably Sarah Hunter (Giles & Franklin). Check the 1830/1840 Luzerne censuses for a Jewel Lamoreaux.
researchNotes:
Son of James Lamoreaux; described in his grandfather's will as 'Jewel Lamoreaux a cripple child' and given a share equal with his aunts.

Giles & Franklin (1962) list James Lamoreux, eldest child of Ensign Thomas Lamoreux, as born 3 Jan 1774. They say he married Sarah Hunter and had ten children, 'among whom were Nathan and Jewell (?)' ([R4-S1]). That makes Sarah Hunter Jewel's probable mother and Nathan a probable brother. The question mark is the authors' own. Nothing else about Jewel, 'a cripple child' in his grandfather's will, was found.
